name: TattooPilot
tagline: Design your tattoo idea with AI, preview it on a model, then take it to your artist.
description:
TattooPilot helps you turn a tattoo idea into a clear concept before you visit an artist. Describe your theme, subject, mood, symbols, or preferred style, and explore AI generated tattoo concepts in different directions.

Compare styles, refine details, and use model previews to consider placement, scale, and balance on different areas of the body. This helps you make decisions with more confidence and communicate your vision without needing to sketch or collect references for hours.

When you find a direction you like, download a structured concept brief to share with a professional tattoo artist. TattooPilot is a planning and inspiration tool: your artist can adapt the final design, line weight, size, and stencil for your body and tattooing technique. Pricing is paid with one-time packs at $9.90, $19.90, and $49.90; there is no subscription.
